artworks.title: Jupiter and Callisto
artworks.medium: graphite on wove(?) paper, laid down
artworks.description: The artwork features a detailed illustration of multiple figures in a natural setting. The central scene shows three figures seated among foliage. A female figure in the center is reclined against another figure, with her face turned towards her companions. Two female figures are engaged in conversation, while a cherubic child reaches towards them. Above, a floating figure is surrounded by clouds and tree branches. In the foreground, hunting dogs rest beside a horn. The background includes trees and clouds, creating a pastoral setting. The illustration is framed with an ornate border and attributed to Ch. Eisen from 1765, depicting the mythological theme of Jupiter taking the form of Diana to seduce the nymph Callisto.

artworks.title: Perseus Turning Phinneas to Stone with the Head of Medusa
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown and gray wash over traces of graphite, with double border line by the artist in pen and gray ink, on laid paper, laid down
artworks.dimensions: image (to outer framing line): 13.4 x 9.1 cm (5 1/4 x 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting Perseus holding up the severed head of Medusa. Another figure, possibly Athena, hovers above with a spear and shield. Onlookers, likely soldiers or warriors, react to Medusa's head. The background features clouds and distant lands. The figures are detailed and wear intricate clothing and armor. The border of the drawing is ornate with decorative elements.

artworks.title: Aurora and Cephalus
artworks.medium: brown chalk with stumping on light beige laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink

artworks.title: La Famine par l'ordre de Ceres ...
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image shows two figures: one lying in bed and the other hovering above. The figure in bed is depicted from the waist up, lying on their back with eyes closed and a serene expression. Their hair is short, and their facial features are relaxed. The hovering figure is shown in semi-profile, with elongated limbs and a dramatic pose reaching towards the person in bed. This figure has long hair and aged features, adding a sense of movement against the stillness below. The bed is draped with flowing bedclothes, and a lit oil lamp sits on a small table beside the bed. The background features billowing clouds, framed by curtains, creating a dream-like setting. The scene is enclosed within an ornate border with floral motifs and text.

artworks.title: La Famine par l'ordre de Cérès vient répandre son venin sur Eresicthon, tandis qu'il dormoit
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with stipple
artworks.description: This is an illustration showing a spectral figure hovering over a person in bed. The bed is detailed with fabric drapery, and a table with a lit candle is nearby. The setting is dark with a mysterious atmosphere, and the room is shaded with clouds. The illustration is framed by decorative flowers and ribbons.

artworks.title: Venus appuyee sur son cher Adonis ...
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on faded blue laid paper

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Iphigenia
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash over traces of graphite with border line by the artist on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of several characters within a scene featuring clouds and classical architecture. The central figure is reclining, surrounded by other figures displaying various emotions and interactions. A winged figure is above, reaching towards the group, accompanied by a ram-like animal. The composition is filled with drapery, gestures, and expressions, creating a dense atmosphere full of narrative and historical elements.

artworks.title: Le Mari sylphe
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and touches of white
artworks.description: This drawing shows two individuals standing together outside under an intricate lattice structure. One person, on the left, is kneeling and reaching out towards the person on the right. The kneeling person has hair styled in tight curls and wears a long coat with ornate details, tight-fitting trousers, and shoes, with a hat on the ground beside them. The person on the right is standing, leaning slightly backward, with one hand raised. They have hair in a tall updo and wear a voluminous dress with ruffled elements. There is an open book by the feet of the standing figure. Above the pair, there is a lattice structure hung with floral garlands. Through a gap in this structure, we can see trees and the corner of a building in the distance. The scene is enclosed in a frame, and a label at the bottom reads "Le Mari Sylphe."

artworks.title: Le Connoisseur
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and touches of white
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a lavishly decorated library or study. One woman stands near an open door, facing a man next to her. The man gestures while looking at her. A seated man at a table, surrounded by papers and a globe, wears a robe and cap. Various items are scattered around the room, such as rolls of paper, a framed canvas, sculptures, a bust, a vase, and a small statue. The room features walls lined with books, a patterned floor, and a sophisticated ambience.

artworks.title: Yes or No
artworks.medium: graphite and red chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a woman in an elaborate gown and pink shoes. Her feet are on the ground, one in front of the other, and she appears to be curtsying or bending down slightly, with her body facing us and her head turned to the right. She has pale skin, large eyes, a slightly upturned nose, and a small mouth. Her light hair is styled high in an ornate fashion with curls, and adorned with a large, decorative hairpiece of pink and white feathers or lace. She is wearing a voluminous pink dress with a very low neckline covered in lace and a pink bow at the center. The enormous pink and white skirts puff out around her, and ruffs of white lace cascade out of her pink sleeves. Some shading indicates where the wall meets the floor behind her, but most of the background is reddish-tan paper.

artworks.title: A Dancer
artworks.medium: black, red, and white chalk on brown laid paper, with a faint border line by the artist in red chalk
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 29.9 x 23 cm (11 3/4 x 9 1/16 in.)
support: 61 x 46.5 cm (24 x 18 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in an elegant pose, balanced on one leg with arms extended. She has a detailed outfit with a hat and ribbon accessories. The background is a simple textured surface.

artworks.title: Fetes venitiennes
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures gathered in an outdoor setting. A woman in a gown stands at the center, surrounded by other seated or reclining figures. The clothing and hairstyles suggest a historical period. Some figures are reclining on the ground, while others are seated or standing. The scene includes an ornate urn, a reclining statue, and lush trees and foliage. The sky above is partially cloudy.

artworks.title: La colation
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with four elegantly dressed individuals gathered on a blanket. The viewpoint is at ground level, with dense foliage obscuring the horizon. The trees are finely detailed, with a monochromatic color palette of gray shades. In the distance, more trees form a natural alcove, and a light source illuminates the scene. The composition conveys a sense of peaceful leisure under the canopy of leaves.

artworks.title: Lecon d'amour
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with figures in elegant clothing gathered around a guitarist. A seated woman and lush foliage are on the left, with rolling hills and a village in the distance. The sky features dramatic clouds. The artwork utilizes a monochromatic palette in tones of beige and sepia, resembling an etching technique.

artworks.title: La famille du fermier
artworks.medium: etching

artworks.title: Les présents du berger
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with elegantly dressed individuals in a lush landscape. The painting has detailed brushstrokes defining the figures and flora, with a horizon featuring trees and distant mountains. The color palette is mainly sepia, highlighting the intricate line work.

artworks.title: Marie-Antoinette
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This print shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is turned slightly to the right, looking at us, and she has white skin and white hair, arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and a small mouth in a neutral expression. Her curled hair is styled in an elaborate updo with small flowers. The woman is wearing an elegant gown with puffed sleeves and lace detailing around the low neckline. She also has a necklace of small pearls or beads, and flower-shaped earrings. The background features an oval frame enclosing the portrait, set against a gray backdrop. Below the oval frame are two small circular designs that look like small crests or shields.

artworks.title: Minerva Crowning the Genius of Fine Arts
artworks.medium: color etching, wash manner, and stipple engraving with gold leaf and hand coloring with silver paint (tarnished) on silk satin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an oval framed scene surrounded by floral garlands. In the center of the composition, there is an oval frame depicting a classical scene with figures in what appears to be a mythological setting. The figures are engaged in an interaction, likely involving a seated figure, a standing one holding a wreath, and possibly a cherub in attendance. Surrounding the central medallion is an elaborate floral garland made up of pink roses with green leaves and blue ribbons curling through the arrangement. The drawing has a refined elegance typical of neoclassical design, with an emphasis on symmetry and balance typically associated with 18th-century European aesthetic.

artworks.title: Louis XVI and Marie-Antoinette
artworks.artist: Jean Pillement, Jean-Baptiste-André Gautier-Dagoty, and Louis Bonvallet
artworks.medium: color etching, wash manner, and stipple engraving with gold leaf and hand coloring with silver paint (tarnished) on silk satin
artworks.description: This print shows two oval portraits side by side, each displaying a bust of a person in profile looking towards the middle. The left portrait features a man with a high forehead, white hair that curls around his ears, a sharp nose, and a soft chin, with his lips set in a slight smile. He is wearing an ornate jacket with ruffles around the neck. The right portrait shows a woman with an ornate hairstyle featuring curls, feathers, pearls, lace, and a cloth veil. She wears a dress with a low neckline trimmed with lace and strands of pearls across her chest. She has a long neck, thin eyebrows, and thin lips. Both portraits are set within blue frames rimmed in gold and surrounding them is a background filled with a garland of pink flowers, green leaves, and blue ribbons. A green wreath is positioned above the two portraits. The background is beige paper.

artworks.title: Seated Woman Sketching a Design for Embroidery and Children Winding Yarn
artworks.medium: color etching, wash manner, and stipple engraving with gold leaf and hand coloring with silver paint (tarnished) on silk satin

artworks.title: Seated Woman Embroidering
artworks.medium: color etching, wash manner, and stipple engraving with gold leaf and hand coloring with silver paint (tarnished) on silk satin
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration encased in an ornate oval frame. The upper half of a woman's body is visible as she is seated and looking up at a cherub who is in flight. The woman has classical facial features and her hair is styled with curls. She is wearing a flowing, classical gown with short sleeves. Next to her is a table with a shallow dish or bowl on it. The cherub is holding a small basket and appears to be presenting something to the woman. Surrounding the main scene is an ornately decorated border featuring intricate floral designs with delicate leaves and blossoms in shades of blue and pink, culminating in a floral ribbon-like ornament at the top. The background is a neutral canvas.

artworks.title: Marie Antoinette d'Autriche (Marie Antoinette of Austria)
artworks.artist: Louis Legoux after Ignazio Pio Vittorio Campana?
artworks.medium: stipple engraving on silk satin
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving depicting a bust view of a person named Marie Antoinette. The person is facing slightly to the right, with detailed facial features including prominent eyes and a small mouth. The hair is curly and styled high above the head. The person is wearing a garment around the shoulders. A decorative bow is above the circular frame surrounding the portrait. The background has a plain, muted texture with text below identifying the person.

artworks.title: Louis XVI
artworks.medium: stipple engraving on silk satin

artworks.title: Francois Boucher
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man turned slightly to his left. He has a prominent nose and a composed expression. His hair is styled in an 18th-century fashion with curls and appears white or gray. He is dressed in formal attire with a high-collared garment and lace cravat. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with decorative elements and the name "F. BOUCHER" below the portrait in a rectangular plaque. The background is a textured surface, giving the piece an engraved style.
